title: The context-conundrum: why existing planning methodologies fail in the integration of water, sanitation and solid waste management services in small towns
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00471C, Paper

Ronald Sakaya, Christoph Lüthi, Abishek S. Narayan, Julian Fritzsche, Alex Y. Katukiza, Charles B. Niwagaba
This study evaluated planning methodologies for integrating water supply, sanitation, hygiene (WASH) and solid waste management (SWM) services in small towns, using Uganda as a case study.
